qarameşə.skip: The Qax village is well attested. The spelling dictionary also lists qarameşəlik, but no reliable passage established the intended common noun.

qaşlıq.skip: The spelling dictionary marks the entry as culinary. Museum and ethnographic sources describe a saddlebag with the same name. The culinary sense remains unresolved.

şivlik.skip: Available sources identify the village or define şiv (a shoot). They do not determine the meaning of the common noun şivlik.
